scope: Western horary; selected Lilly 1647 general doctrine and worked-figure catalogue

sources.author: William Lilly
sources.title: Christian Astrology
sources.publisher: Thomas Brudenell for John Partridge and Humphrey Blunden
sources.copy_note: Last leaf wanting, per catalogue; selected pages present

source_units.title: Remaining prerequisites and detailed topic doctrine

rule_families.paraphrase: Erection depends on the stated date, clock and local ephemeris procedure. P.41 explicitly converts a morning to hours after the preceding noon.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Literal date/time; calendar, year start, clock origin, locality, conversion receipt. Never treat printed P.M. automatically as modern civil PM.

rule_families.paraphrase: Houses have distinct topics, angular/succedent/cadent condition and source-specific strength.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Caller-confirmed question facts, actual cusp/placement geometry and topic passage; a house label is not a complete judgement.

rule_families.paraphrase: A related person's house becomes their first; other houses are counted from it. Who asks can change the perspective.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Explicit entity/relationship path and inclusive count, with the radical anchor retained.

rule_families.paraphrase: The querent is represented by the Ascendant/lord; the thing demanded by its appropriate house/lord. Other planets can contribute.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Question context, cusp-sign rulers, descriptive/co-significator evidence; do not silently replace a collided principal.

rule_families.paraphrase: Moon is co-significator of the querent; Lilly rejects making its last separated planet co-significator by that fact alone.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Moon's roles and sequence independent of the principal pair. The following next-applying/co-quesited discussion needs contextual resolution.

rule_families.paraphrase: Dignity and peregrinity depend on specific essential dignities at a place; reception also enters the fortitude table.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Versioned Lilly table, sect and degree bounds; do not substitute a generic term/triplicity table or turn fortitude into probability.

rule_families.paraphrase: Planetary full orbs have two printed alternatives; contact range uses the sum of their halves.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Named selected table and exact boundary policy. Current fixed values are not the sole table allowed by this source.

rule_families.paraphrase: Application has direct/direct, retrograde/retrograde and mixed-motion forms; partile, dexter/sinister and sign-beholding are distinct notions.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Directed separation, relative motion, aspect branch, orb and sign relation. Planetary weight is not automatically instantaneous speed.

rule_families.paraphrase: Separation begins at six arcminutes in the description, but complete separation is beyond the combined moieties.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Distinguish exact root, partile status, initial separation and full departure from an orb.

rule_families.paraphrase: Reception is described through mutual dignity, with examples in several bases, and can assist without an aspect or through adverse aspects.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Directed dignity relations, mutuality, basis, context and epoch; mechanism-specific reception requirements must remain distinct.

rule_families.paraphrase: VOC concerns separation followed by no further application during the sign; p.122 qualifies the consequence by principal strength and signs.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Source definition of application, lunar sequence/sign boundary, and separately encoded exceptions; no automatic universal denial.

rule_families.paraphrase: Combustion is described as corporal proximity in the same sign within 8 degrees 30 minutes; beams and cazimi have distinct thresholds.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Sun/planet longitudes and signs, direction if relevant, endpoint policy; record the apparent inconsistent numerical example.

rule_families.paraphrase: Hour agreement can concern lord identity, triplicity or nature; the question and erection context matter.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Bound question-time/location receipt, day/night hour, sign lord/triplicity/nature and the source examples.

rule_families.paraphrase: Early/late Ascendant cautions include descriptive/age exceptions; the late caution also distinguishes known-event figures.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Degree, caller-supplied age/description and figure purpose; lack of context is not proof that an exception fails.

rule_families.paraphrase: Late Moon and Via Combusta are cautions with source qualifications. VOC is mitigated in named signs and by strong principals.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Moon sign/degree, strength evidence and source hedge; avoid treating all cautions as strict prohibitions.

rule_families.paraphrase: Saturn and seventh-house/lord warnings concern different risks; the artist/seventh caution depends on question context.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Actual placements/condition and whether the matter concerns the seventh. Keep judgement reliability and matter difficulty separate.

rule_families.paraphrase: Balanced fortunate and unfortunate testimonies counsel deferral; combust Ascendant lord and other conditions add cautions.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Source-defined testimony types, not a count of arbitrary votes or a fabricated confidence threshold.

rule_families.paraphrase: Conjunction can perfect under conditions of placement, strength/motion and no interruption; house class modifies the account.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Exact contact plus role-specific condition and intervening events. Contact alone is not the complete proposition.

rule_families.paraphrase: Sextile/trine perfection is qualified by good houses, dignity and absence of intervening malefic testimony.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Qualifiers and their epochs; distinguish the astronomical aspect from the source judgement.

rule_families.paraphrase: Square perfection is possible with dignity and suitable houses.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Explicit source-conditioned route; neither unconditional success nor unconditional failure follows from square alone.

rule_families.paraphrase: Opposition requires additional reception/house/Moon conditions in this discussion and can lead to regret or expense.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Mutual domicile reception, house and Moon sequence evidence; completion and desirability are separate propositions.

rule_families.paraphrase: Translation joins significators through a lighter intermediary; the fuller perfection passage adds reception and contact/history conditions.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Two directed legs, source receiving translator in house/triplicity/term, no intervening contact, principal relationship history and epochs.

rule_families.paraphrase: Collection concerns principals that do not behold one another, both contacting a heavier collector which each receives.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Both principal-to-collector applications, directed reception by each principal, heaviness, chronology and beholding definition.

rule_families.paraphrase: Prohibition is an intervening action preventing the intended completion; the source distinguishes bodily and aspectual forms.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Intended application and relevant third-party sequence; do not assume every intervening contact is prohibition.

rule_families.paraphrase: Refranation interrupts an intended application by reversal before completion.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Application, station/reversal and failure to complete; an actual later exact aspect is not a necessary historical premise.

rule_families.paraphrase: Frustration describes an intended bodily conjunction defeated when the heavier significator first joins another.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Conjunction-specific intended and intervening relationships; do not generalize automatically to every aspect.

rule_families.paraphrase: Dwelling in the relevant house is attributed to earlier authorities, but Lilly declines to rely on it without the Moon carrying the virtue.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Preserve the author's rejection/qualification; do not add an unconditional seventh success mechanism.

rule_families.paraphrase: Angular/succedent/cadent contexts modify speed/ease of accomplishment in the general perfection discussion.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Qualitative timing only here. An exact aspect timestamp does not determine symbolic weeks, months or years.

rule_families.paraphrase: House strength, Hayz, oriental/occidental condition, besiegement and the fortitude table supply distinct condition evidence.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Separate definitions, sect, body group and table entries. Table scores and ordered comparisons are not one interchangeable judgement scale.

rule_families.paraphrase: Book III recommends exact Regiomontanus construction for nativities and describes it as more scrupulous than ordinary questions need.
rule_families.required_evidence_and_limits: Auxiliary scope evidence; it does not impose one universal horary house-method default.

ambiguities.issue: Noon-origin hours, AM/PM wording, Julian/Gregorian calendar and year-start style are separate axes.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve raw strings. Per-case conversion must explain date rollover, year and locality before a JD/UT value is allowed; use E03 as an independent clock fixture.

ambiguities.issue: Source houses, current house API policy and boundary/placement rules need a named contract. P.491 does not settle all ordinary-question defaults.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve supplied house policy; no silent method substitution. Document planet/cusp boundary and turning behavior separately.

ambiguities.issue: Two entities can have one planetary lord; Moon and other source roles can overlap.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve collisions and candidate roles. Require a source-specific alternative rule rather than inventing a replacement significator.

ambiguities.issue: Labels such as Ptolemaic, Egyptian or traditional can conceal different cells, sect handling or endpoint conventions.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Bind the actual p.104 table and double-enter every cell needed by fixtures. Current policy already names Lilly; old validation prose is stale.

ambiguities.issue: P.107 prints two orb sets; p.110's Saturn/Jupiter example uses the second. The current fixed table mixes values from these alternatives.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve all three tables below as separately identified data. Selecting a future table needs an explicit profile decision and paired boundary fixtures.

ambiguities.issue: Six-arcminute separation, partile equality, orbital contact and a solver's root tolerance answer different questions.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Specify separate fields and endpoint tests; never use a historical arc threshold as a root-finding error tolerance.

ambiguities.issue: Lighter/heavier can mean traditional planetary order; the implementation uses absolute instantaneous speed. Stations can change their relation.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Collate mechanism examples and practice; specify which notion each mechanism requires, including direct/retrograde motion.

ambiguities.issue: Mutual reception, directed reception and mechanism-specific bases differ; current generic and perfection APIs use incompatible receiver vocabulary.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Define host as dignity ruler and guest as occupant in plain terms. Explicit adapters and same-/mixed-basis tests precede reuse.

ambiguities.issue: P.112 permits reception to assist even without an aspect; the broad statement does not fully operationalize every outcome.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Keep a reception-without-aspect candidate route, unadmitted until context and counterexamples are collated. Do not infer universal success.

ambiguities.issue: P.112's application during a sign can be read through orb/application or exact-completion criteria; these differ near an ingress.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve alternatives; specify event universe, bounds and what counts as application. The generic VOC helper is not automatically Lilly's definition.

ambiguities.issue: P.122's strong principals and sign exceptions do not supply a universal numeric strength threshold.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Encode named qualitative evidence and unknown context. A threshold needs source/practice support, not an arbitrary score.

ambiguities.issue: Same-sign combustion differs from a distance-only band, especially across a sign boundary; threshold inclusivity is not fully formalized.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Test equal distance in same/different signs; maintain source and geometric evidence separately. Cazimi/beams need their own endpoint decisions.

ambiguities.issue: P.113 defines 8 degrees 30 minutes but appears to call Jupiter 28 Aries with Sun 18 Aries combust.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Retain literal readings; collate alternate photograph before proposing an erratum. Do not silently change 28 to 26 or widen the threshold.

ambiguities.issue: Early/late exceptions, artist/seventh warnings and Via Combusta's qualified attribution resist universal boolean denial.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Require context inputs and distinguish caution, exception, unknown and not applicable. Preserve the source hedge.

ambiguities.issue: P.124 rejects the Moon's last-separated planet as co-querent; the ensuing next-applying/co-quesited passage needs contextual reading.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Record those as different propositions. Check worked practice before admitting an automatic new role.

ambiguities.issue: Good/friendly houses, strong planets, malefic intervention and opposition regret need definitions and scope.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Separate R18-R21; give every qualifier a predicate or typed unresolved state. An exact contact cannot stand in for all of them.

ambiguities.issue: P.111 gives a structural definition; p.126 adds principal-history and reception conditions. When must reception/strength hold?
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Keep both source contexts. Test history, allowed bases, direction, intervening contacts and initial versus event-time changes.

ambiguities.issue: Not beholding may concern sign relation rather than present orb; reception of the collector and heavier status need explicit epochs.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Preserve the source's reception direction. Compare sign/aspect alternatives and changing dignity before the last contact.

ambiguities.issue: Current blockers require an eligible actual future pair contact. A reversal can prevent the contact altogether.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Specify intended application independently from completed event search. Add blocked/no-exact fixtures before expanding admission. No repair is made here.

ambiguities.issue: Current prior-event filters exclude events within the advertised one-second tie band before the tie predicate examines them.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Add independent exact/near-simultaneous station, ingress and third-contact fixtures. Treat this as a code gap, not a historical ambiguity.

ambiguities.issue: Current witnesses retain the first translation/collection candidate; a 31-day boundary is a safety limit, not doctrine.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Future output must preserve all candidates, dependencies and unresolved frontier. Do not chain windows while discarding cross-boundary state.

ambiguities.issue: A catalogue that lists the dwelling shortcut without Lilly's rejection would misattribute earlier doctrine to him.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Source handling resolved: record as rejected/qualified in Lilly. Any positive mechanism still requires Moon evidence under the admitted rule.

ambiguities.issue: Event time, qualitative speed, symbolic units and a reported historical duration have different evidence.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: No universal degree-to-unit conversion in the core. Later timing admission must state context, alternatives and uncertainty.

ambiguities.issue: Printed coordinates, modern reconstructions, author-reported outcomes and independent outcomes are different records. Fish years differ; some epochs are absent.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Null normalized fields, record variants and source qualification; separate reused/hypothetical/event cases and exclude leakage from predictive sets.

ambiguities.issue: P.48 orders house strength; p.115 gives grouped point values and extra conditions. Their granularity and purpose differ.
ambiguities.disposition_and_closure: Keep ordered comparison and tabulated fortitude separate. Double-enter the table before any computation; never turn its sum into a universal verdict.
